navbar-title: Application title displayed at the top left of the navigation bar.
navbar-home: Navigation link to the home page.
navbar-edit-counts: Navigation link to the page showing edit counts.
navbar-editor-counts: Navigation link to the page showing the number of editors.
navbar-watchlist: Navigation link to the user's watchlist page.
navbar-loading: Text shown in the navigation bar while the user's login status is being checked.
navbar-login: Label of the button that logs the user in.
navbar-logout: Label of the button that logs the user out.
navbar-open-menu: Accessible label (screen readers) of the button that opens the mobile navigation menu.
navbar-close-menu: Accessible label (screen readers) of the button that closes the mobile navigation menu.
common-edits: Label for the number of edits. Used as a chart legend, a tooltip label and a table column header when the data counts edits.
common-editors: Table column header when the data counts editors (distinct users) instead of edits.
common-date: Label for a date. Used as a table column header.
activitychart-title-default: Default heading of the activity chart card, shown when no specific title is provided.
activitychart-subtitle-default: Default description under the activity chart heading, shown when no specific subtitle is provided.
activitychart-legend-alerts: Chart legend entry for the diamond markers showing months with unusually high activity.
activitychart-download-csv: Label of the button that downloads the displayed chart data as a CSV file.
activitychart-download-image: Label of the button that downloads the chart as a PNG image.
activitychart-empty-title: Heading of the empty state shown when the chart has no data.
activitychart-empty-text: Instruction shown under the empty chart heading, asking the user to choose a project and a date range.
activitychart-trace-alert: Name of the data series made of high activity alert markers on the chart.
activitychart-hover-peak: Bold heading of the tooltip shown when hovering an alert marker.
activitychart-hover-edits: Tooltip line showing the edit count.Parameters:n* $1 - the value, inserted by the chart library (do not translate or alter).
activitychart-hover-date: Tooltip line showing the date of an alert.Parameters:n* $1 - the date, inserted by the chart library (do not translate or alter).
activitychart-axis-x: Title of the horizontal axis of the activity chart (months or dates).
activitychart-axis-y: Title of the vertical axis of the activity chart (number of edits).
peakstable-title: Heading of the table listing dates with peak activity alerts.
peakstable-subtitle: Description under the peak table heading. A peak is a date where edit volume exceeded the rolling mean.
peakstable-col-count: Fallback column header for the activity count, used when it is unknown whether edits or editors are counted.
peakstable-col-rolling-mean: Column header: the rolling mean (moving average) of activity at the peak date.
peakstable-col-threshold: Column header: the activity value above which a date is flagged as a peak.
peakstable-col-diff: Column header: percentage difference between the peak value and the rolling mean. Keep it short.
peakstable-col-annotation: Column header: note explaining the cause of a peak, written by a user.
peakstable-annotation-view-source: Link text opening the source cited in an annotation, in a new tab.
peakstable-annotation-by: Credit line under an annotation.Parameters: n* $1 - username of the person who submitted the annotation.
peakstable-annotation-edit: Button label to edit an existing annotation. This is a verb.
peakstable-annotation-add: Button label to add an annotation to a peak that has none.
peakstable-empty-title: Heading of the empty state shown when no peaks were detected.
peakstable-empty-text: Text under the empty state heading, saying activity was normal over the period.
